open_gates.distinct_markings: product over i<j of (s_i*t_j-t_i*s_j) is nonzero
open_gates.nonzero_lambdas: product over i of lambda_i is nonzero

open_gates.PGL2_rigidification: quotient by PGL2, or put three ordered markings at [1:0],[0:1],[1:1]

saturated_incidence.degree_and_birationality: basepoint freeness gives pullback O(1)=O(19); the 55 target points span P3, so the image is not a line; since 19 is prime, the map is birational onto a nondegenerate integral degree-19 image

dimension_ledger.status: virtual only; dependence of the special 55 conditions is the unresolved rank question

smooth_fixed_fibre_tangent_obstruction.proof_of_bounds: N_C/P3(-1) is globally generated, so b_i>=0; nondegeneracy gives H0(Omega_P3(1)|C)=0, hence H0(N_C/P3^*(1))=0 and b_i cannot be zero
smooth_fixed_fibre_tangent_obstruction.relative_hyperplane_formula: for the rank r of T_h P4 -> H1(N(-Z)), tangent=4-r and obstruction=34-r, with 0<=r<=4
smooth_fixed_fibre_tangent_obstruction.scope: smooth embedded rational candidates only; it does not cover singular rational images

full_quintic_substitution_matrix.columns: all degree-5 monomials in X0,X1,X2,X3 after substitution by the four binary degree-19 map forms
full_quintic_substitution_matrix.epsilon0: rank 56, so I_C(5)=0 and Rao degree-5 dimension is 40
full_quintic_substitution_matrix.epsilon1: rank 55, so dim I_C(5)=1 and Rao degree-5 dimension is 41

compressed_point_ideal_matrix.columns: restrictions of f3 times the ten quadrics, followed by f5
compressed_point_ideal_matrix.epsilon1: rank 10 with one-dimensional kernel whose f5 coordinate is nonzero; normalize it to f5+f3*q
compressed_point_ideal_matrix.justification: any quintic containing C also contains its 55 marked points, and I_Z(5)=f3*S2 plus <f5>

special_quintic_carrier.family: S_q: f5+f3*q=0, q in H0(P3,O(2)), an affine 10-dimensional family
special_quintic_carrier.base_curve: Y=V(f3,f5) is a smooth (3,5) complete intersection and Y is linearly equivalent to 3H on S_q
special_quintic_carrier.adjunction: if S_q and C are smooth, K_S=H and -2=C^2+H.C, hence C^2=-21
special_quintic_carrier.consequence: a smooth epsilon1 candidate forces the actual carrier either to be singular or to lie in the Noether-Lefschetz locus carrying the displayed discriminant-466 lattice; a very-general Picard-rank-one carrier cannot contain C
special_quintic_carrier.nonconsequence: this does not exclude the special carrier selected by an unknown curve
